attempts.summary: Implemented cross-LAN firewall via Ansible from control node4: node1 (VyOS) routes lan-a (10.50.1.0/24, node2) and lan-b (10.50.2.0/24, node3), with a forward-filter policy that allows only node2->node3 TCP/5432 (plus established/related) and drops all other cross-LAN traffic. Verified end-to-end (ICMP blocked, TCP/22 blocked, TCP/5432 succeeds) both before and after restarting all four managed nodes one at a time, with saved VyOS config and NetworkManager/firewalld state confirmed to persist across reboot.
